_: The King's decrees as data (consolidation B5): what each costs (in hundreds of crowns), its name, and what it does in a few words for the town card (effect; courtEffect when ordered at his own seat). crown.js decides what happens; the view shows these words, never its own. courtOnly: given only as an answer to a matter at court (cmd.matter), never from a town card. oncePerHouse: a house has it of the King once a reign. promise: the free answer to a crisis the purse can't pay (gameplay review #1): the house gains favour, the King's most favoured house (rival) loses it. cede: the free answer to a march on Kingsmere: a royal town for their claim (their host goes home). ward: favour is what the house thinks of its heir taken; seasons, how long it cannot rise (gameplay review #2: 20 crowns-hundreds and -5 made it a repeatable free win).
